selected_skills.name: paprika
selected_skills.selection_reason: This is the action-enabling skill for accessing scheduled meals, recipes, and grocery carryovers through the Paprika CLI command surface.

selected_skills.name: healthy-eating
selected_skills.selection_reason: This adds the nutrition-audit framing without changing the operational source of truth.

design_goals: Keep the task as a meal-operations construction task rather than a repair prompt.
Bind the official upstream skills under environment/skills so the runtime can expose their documented workflows.
Make the Paprika workspace the operational authority while keeping the task deterministic and fully verifiable.
Concentrate without-skill failures on action-level misses such as incomplete Paprika retrieval, skipped carryover review, or incorrect ingredient consolidation.

input_data.source: Task-local delivery brief shaped around a culinary workshop operations packet.
input_data.notes: Defines the service dates, guest count, carryover rule, and per-person nutrition targets.
Provides exact ingredient_id-based deductions that may be applied before any additional buying is planned.

input_data.source: Task-local Paprika-style recipe, meal-plan, and grocery datasets.
input_data.notes: These files back the local Paprika CLI and are used by the verifier to recompute the expected outputs.

environment_design.determinism: A local Paprika CLI reads fixed seed data for recipes, scheduled meals, and grocery carryovers. The verifier recomputes the manifest, nutrition audit, and shopping delta from those seeds instead of trusting filenames or freeform text.
anti_toy_features: scheduled meals span three service dates and six distinct lunch or dinner slots
ingredient consolidation spans repeated ingredients across multiple recipes and dates
shopping deductions must combine pantry allowances with both purchased and unpurchased reserved carryovers
per-day nutrition checks depend on scheduled recipe details rather than visible brief text alone
the Paprika CLI access log allows workflow verification without exposing command details in the task text

main_tests: meal manifest schema and exact scheduled-meal coverage
shopping delta recomputation from recipes, pantry allowances, and carryovers
nutrition audit recomputation for every service date
kitchen notes structure and content coverage
guardrails: runtime skill area is present only in the with-skill variant, and the no-skill variant stays empty
Paprika access logs show date-scoped meal retrieval, recipe-detail retrieval, and carryover review
no extra top-level outputs are created

with_without_difference_policy: Only environment/skills/ and the corresponding runtime skill-copy logic may differ between with_skill and without_skill variants.
iteration_notes: Do not rely on editing the bundled skill payloads to complete the task.
Keep instruction business-facing and avoid documenting the Paprika command chain there.
Treat without-skill failures as invalid unless at least one verifier check still fails for an action-level reason.
